8b47fb94-18d2-4b55-8764-5ff4a2d24b19.description: Error ratio over 5m is above 14.4x the 1% error budget (fast burn); at this rate a 30-day budget lasts about 2 days.

facts.statement: checkout's error ratio is about 0.40 at 15:50, up from about 0.20 at 15:44.
checkout revision 2, created 15:42:52, has the change cause 'payment client moved to port 9999'. Revision 1 was created at 15:30:16.
The diff between revisions is PAYMENT_ADDR changed from payment:8080 to payment:9999 and nothing else.
Checkout's error traces show 'dial tcp 10.96.40.41:9999: i/o timeout' on PaymentService/Charge and PlaceOrder, and frontend returns HTTP 500 on POST /api/checkout.
Checkout's client Charge calls from the new pod (checkout-6f48f6dcc5) start returning STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 15:43:45, and the old pod's successful calls stop at about the same time.
Checkout's own logs have no error-level lines in the 30 minutes before 15:50.
Payment has no error-ratio series at 15:50, and its last logs are at 15:42:50 with only info lines. Its rollout is a single revision from 15:30:15 and its events are normal.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check the payment Service ports and the container's listening port. Then check that a call to payment:8080 succeeds.
hypotheses.statement: Payment's Kubernetes Service and container do not expose port 9999, so nothing listens there.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Run rollout undo on checkout and watch service:sli_error_ratio:rate5m for checkout fall toward zero.
hypotheses.statement: Rolling checkout back to revision 1 (PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080) should restore the error ratio to baseline.

inferences.statement: The fault is in checkout's configuration, not in payment. Payment is idle and healthy, and the failing dial target is the port introduced by the 15:42:52 change.

root_causes.cause: Config release at 15:42:52 pointed PAYMENT_ADDR at payment:9999, but payment serves on 8080. Checkout cannot dial payment, so charges time out and every PlaceOrder fails.

diagnosis.summary: checkout fails about 40% of requests since 15:42-15:44. Its only rollout (revision 2 at 15:42:52) changed PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999. Since then every PaymentService/Charge call from checkout fails with 'dial tcp 10.96.40.41:9999: i/o timeout', and the failures bubble up through frontend and frontend-proxy as HTTP 500. Payment shows no errors of its own, no rollout, and no warning events, and its logs stop at 15:42:50 because it receives no traffic. The most likely cause is the bad port in checkout's config.

actions.reason: Revision 2 (15:42:52, 'payment client moved to port 9999') changed only PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999. Checkout now times out dialing 9999 on every Charge, which fails PlaceOrder. Revision 1 has payment:8080, the port payment serves on.

alternatives.why_not: A restart keeps PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:9999, so the new pods would fail the same way. Nothing here points to a stuck process.
The failures are dial timeouts to a wrong port, not a capacity shortage, so more replicas would only add more failing pods.
The release is clearly identified and the rollback is a known-good prior revision, so waiting would extend the fast burn on a P1.

plan.summary: Roll checkout back to revision 1, which restores PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080 and undoes the 15:42:52 release that pointed checkout at a port payment does not serve. Expect checkout's error ratio to drop back toward the ~0.20 baseline seen before 15:44 and then clear, with payment:8080 Charge calls succeeding again.
